text: Managing a team is not always easy, but good leaders use several important skills. First, clear communication helps everyone understand their tasks and goals. Second, delegation means trusting team members with responsibilities, which saves time and develops their abilities. Third, regular feedback allows people to improve and feel valued. Motivation is also key; simple things like saying "thank you" or recognising hard work can make a big difference. Finally, when disagreements happen, a good leader listens to both sides and finds a fair solution. By using these skills, you can build a happy, productive team where everyone works well together.
